rules.vrs_model: Valve Glicko expected-score formula, RD=75.0 (Valve's fit.js default), slope k fitted against joined market lines

rules.blank_policy: a probability is published only when derivable from a retained source; otherwise the cell stays blank and the fixture is ledgered as unresolved

rules.seed_policy: untrained seed prices (exact 1.80/1.80 placeholders with zero votes, $0-volume markets, wide bid/ask seeds, overround > 0.30) are rejected, not averaged
